description: Election Commission - Declare that Mr. N. R. M. P. Nawarathna as Chairman of the Ruwanwella Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy for the Chairman of a local authority (Ruwanwella Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for a local government position, including the nomination by a political party and the official declaration of the elected Chairman by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related matters for local authorities.
